class.name: SteamAchievements
class.brief_description: Submits single achievement unlocks for the owning Steamworks attachment.
class.description: Get this service from [method Steamworks.achievements]. Call it on the main thread. It shares the same stats service and validation as a [SteamStatsEdit] from this attachment.

method.name: unlock
method.description: Validates the published achievement API name, sets its cached state, and asks Steam to store the change. Success means Steam accepted the storage request. [signal SteamStats.stats_stored] reports Steam's later app-wide storage result. The submission result retains how many cache changes were applied even when Steam rejects the storage request. An expired scope returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE].
